style: Create EXACTLY 2x2 contact sheet: four equal cinematic 16:9 stills, thin straight central gutters, no extra panels, no text, logos, captions or collage. Detailed realistic Tamil Shaivite devotional cinema, culturally authentic South Indian temples, natural light, gentle depth, believable anatomy. Four DISTINCT shots top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right in specified order. Keep bottom corners free of lamps/incense, added later. No static lightning bolts. Dry interiors; no rain streaks anywhere, animated drizzle added later to scene eleven.
